title: An item that changes only the workspace's own files cannot carry touches in a multi-repository workspace: check asks for repos, and repos refuses workspace (Nerthus adoption)
goal: In a workspace whose backlog.json declares repositories, an item whose touches are all workspace/<glob> is accepted with no repos, so a sprint sweep or a ledger task that edits only the workspace can be moved into an active sprint and dispatched; touches naming a declared repository still require repos

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",d]); os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,"r")); open(os.path.join(d,"backlog.json"),"w").write(json.dumps({"repositories":{"r":"r"}})); b=[sys.executable,os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py"),"--root",d]; o=subprocess.run(b+["new","story","--title","w","--goal","g","--check","true"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; i=o.split()[2]; r=subprocess.run(b+["set",i,"--touch","workspace/notes.md"],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(1 if r.returncode else 0)
